name: reviewing-skills
description: Reviews and grades an agent skill directory (SKILL.md plus supporting resources) for specification compliance, clarity, token efficiency, safety, robustness, and portability. Produces an evidence-cited weighted score and grade, P1/P2/P3 findings with minimal patch text, and a machine-readable verdict with structured findings for generator-critic loops. Offers full, triage, and incremental review depths; single, batch, comparative, forensic, and ensemble modes; and an opt-in behavioral probe. Use when a user wants a skill folder reviewed, graded, audited, or compared. Not for writing or refactoring skills (use writing-skills).
